method.rule: Each visible marking is an independent evidence-bound component; no port/starboard mirroring and no freehand completion from symmetry.
method.surfaceBinding: Project each component to the inherited curved Mother-01 skin with the existing raycast decal mechanism; do not flatten the nose into one billboard.
method.unknownPolicy: Unknown values remain unknown. They are not completed for visual neatness.
method.photoStatePolicy: Mission and victory markings are time-dependent. A final historical build may not combine unmatched photo states. Unsynchronised evidence stays in review overlays only.
method.tracePolicy: The photographed 80 DAYS lettering and dice contours must come from photo-pixel tracing. Generic fonts and default dice pip layouts are review-invalid.
